body.name: hatGammaLap
body.def: Recover \(a_T=(\kappa_{TTTT}/3)^{1/4}\), \(a_i=\kappa_{iTTT}/(3a_T^3)\), and set \(\widehat\Gamma_N^{\mathrm{Lap}}=\operatorname{clip}_{[\lambda,\Lambda]}(\widehat{\operatorname{Cov}}(X)-\widehat a\widehat a^\top)\), using clipped empirical moments and a positive cumulant floor
